name: An Overdue Notice
text: A pink slip of paper, furious about a book you have never borrowed.

name: A Bookmark Moth
text: It lays its eggs at page 47 of every abandoned novel. It is very busy.

name: A Price Sticker Swarm
text: Two hundred stickers that will not peel off cleanly. They know it.

name: A Feral Dust Jacket
text: Escaped from its hardback years ago. Flaps menacingly. Has no spine.

name: The Receipt Golem
text: Every receipt the till ever printed, folded into a man. It wants a refund.

name: A Mouth-Breathing Audiobook
text: Reads itself aloud at full volume, doing all the voices badly.

name: The Returns Bin Mimic
text: Looks like a returns bin. Accepts returns. Also accepts readers.

name: A Very Large Beetle
text: Insists it is a travelling salesman and is late for the five o'clock train.

name: A Grin Without a Cat
text: Only the grin remains. It is hard to hit something that is mostly absent.

name: The Clearance Box Hydra
text: Sell one book and two more appear in the box. Everything is 50p.

name: The Bookshop Cat
text: Owns the shop. Tolerates the owner. Has never tolerated you.

special.name: Off the Shelf
special.text: It looks at you, then at a heavy dictionary on the top shelf. Then it pushes. Slowly.

name: The Jabberwock
text: Jaws that bite, claws that catch, and a vocabulary nobody can follow.

special.name: Burbling
special.text: It comes whiffling through the tulgey wood and burbles at you. Somehow that hurts.

name: An Erratum Slip
text: For 'you are safe' read 'you are not safe'. The publisher regrets the error.

name: A Damp Filing Cabinet
text: Four drawers of mould and one drawer of teeth. Guess which one opens.

name: The Microfiche Wraith
text: A newspaper from 1923, shrunk and bitter. It glows faintly in the reader.

name: The Card Catalogue Centipede
text: A thousand legs, each one a drawer, each drawer filed under the wrong letter.

name: An Angry Ibid.
text: Refers to the same place as before. Hits you in the same place as before.

name: The Silverfish Sommelier
text: Tastes the binding glue of every book. Finds your spine full-bodied.

name: A Scrivener Who Prefers Not
text: He would prefer not to fight. He would also prefer not to move out of your way.

name: A Gigantic Hound
text: Glowing jaws, enormous paws, last seen on a moor. Nobody explains it here.

name: Mr Hyde, After Hours
text: A small, unpleasant man who tramples readers in the corridors. Dislikes mornings.

source.author: Robert Louis Stevenson
source.work: Strange Case of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde

name: The Shredder
text: Confidential waste with an appetite. It turns readers into strips.

name: A Stack of Unread Classics
text: Every book you said you had read. They have come to check.

name: The Overdue Librarian
text: Has been waiting since 1887 for a book to come back. It is you. You are the book.

special.name: Compound Late Fee
special.text: Your fine doubles. Then it doubles again. Interest is a weapon and she is fluent in it.

name: The Phantom of the Archive
text: A masked figure who lives under the stacks and has opinions about your humming.

special.name: The Chandelier
special.text: A chandelier of reading lamps falls from the ceiling. Nobody installed a chandelier. That is the point.
